intended_use: Sproto Fighter Trenches stage fight theme (all Trenches levels and maps, Story and Level Select), seamless loop
notes: 192 bars of 4/4 at 128 BPM is 360 s (17,280,000 samples at 48 kHz). The container is 360.024 s because of MP3 priming (1105 samples, start time 0.023021 s) and one trailing frame. Chrome decodeAudioData and ffmpeg drop that priming and land on exactly 17,280,000 samples, so loopStart is 0 and loopEnd is 360 s. The wrap step is about 0.0007, under a normal sample step, so no seam ramp is applied. Decoded stereo float PCM is 138,240,000 bytes. That one buffer is acceptable: the file is fetched ahead of the fight and decoded on the shared AudioBuffer player, and a media element would not keep this MP3 gapless. A failed decode still falls back to the synthesised fight loop. No loudness trim.
